procedures.title: Neutral safety switch replacement
steps: Disconnect the shift control lever arm from the control rod.
Remove the trim plate screws and trim plate.
Remove the control assembly screws (see Section 1).
Lift the control assembly out of its seal.
Remove the switch nuts and take the switch off the control assembly.
To install, put the shifter in "Drive", line up the hole in the contact support with the hole in the switch, and insert a 3/32" diameter pin to hold the support.
Fit the contact support drive slot over the drive tang and tighten the switch mounting screws.
Connect the harness to the switch wiring.
Refit the trim plate and shift knob.
Reconnect the shift lever arm to the transmission control rod.
